mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is above its 3-year median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuation multiples by increasing the discount rate, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above its 3-year median, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens economic growth and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it indicates persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) creates a 'stagflation' regime that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above 100 and housing starts (HOUST) are above 1250, it signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100 AND HOUST > 1250, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low housing market regimes (HOUST < 1200), the S&P 500 tends to rebound as investors anticipate policy support and economic stabilization, producing positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
